qa_pair.question: Inspect the XR capability contract. Which portable immersive runtime does the editor implement?
Inspect XR capabilities and target-validation evidence. Which four native provider families remain outside the portable core? Answer as a comma-separated list in reported order.
Inspect a default XR configuration. How many centimetre-based editor scene units represent one WebXR metre?
Inspect XR session capabilities. Which two immersive session modes are supported? Answer as a comma-separated list in reported order.
Inspect the strict XR configuration mutation contract. May one native feature be requested as both required and optional? Respond True or False.
Inspect desktop XR simulation behavior. Are transient camera and grabbed-mesh transforms restored when simulation stops? Respond True or False.
Inspect XR simulation schemas and tool descriptions. Which units are used for persisted simulator position and rotation values?
Inspect the enter_xr_session contract. Can an external CLI bypass the browser's real user-activation requirement? Respond True or False.
Inspect XR target validation. Does a normal build/authoring audit require probing the current headset or browser device? Respond True or False.
Inspect XR interaction capabilities. Which three authored mesh interaction modes are supported? Answer as a comma-separated list in reported order.
